Container.Name: Sermon Manager
Container.Overview: Church LAN app. There is no login. Do not expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web UI. The container listens on 8080.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: SQLite database directory. The database file is /data/sermons.db.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Uploads, normalized media, and backfill downloads.

Config.Name: Secrets
Config.Description: YouTube and Spotify JSON files. This path must stay writable.

Config.Name: Whisper Host
Config.Description: Optional. Host of whisper-asr-webservice. Empty leaves the transcript pending. Port defaults to 9000.

Config.Name: LLM Host
Config.Description: Optional. Host of Ollama. Empty uses an extractive summary. Port defaults to 11434.

Config.Name: YouTube Client Secrets
Config.Description: OAuth client JSON. Used only to mint the YouTube token.

Config.Name: YouTube Token File
Config.Description: Authorized-user token. Must be writable because a refresh rewrites this file.

Config.Name: YouTube Privacy
Config.Description: public, unlisted, or private.

Config.Name: YouTube Category
Config.Description: YouTube category id. 22 is People and Blogs.

Config.Name: YouTube Playlist
Config.Description: Optional uploads playlist id, often starting with UU.

Config.Name: Facebook Page ID
Config.Description: Facebook Page id. Leave empty to skip Facebook.

Config.Name: Facebook Page Token
Config.Description: Page access token. Leave empty to skip Facebook.

Config.Name: Facebook Graph Version
Config.Description: Graph API version.

Config.Name: Facebook Video Host
Config.Description: Host for video upload.

Config.Name: Facebook Graph Host
Config.Description: Host for listing videos and description updates.

Config.Name: Facebook App ID
Config.Description: Optional. Set only to use the Resumable Upload API.

Config.Name: Spotify Storage State
Config.Description: Playwright storage-state JSON. A missing file skips Spotify.

Config.Name: Spotify Show URL
Config.Description: Spotify for Creators show dashboard.

Config.Name: Spotify Headless
Config.Description: true or false.

Config.Name: Spotify Upload Timeout
Config.Description: How long to wait for Spotify to accept the file, in milliseconds.
